title: Stairway Resurfacing underway in Downtown Parking Structures
description:
Stairway resurfacing is underway in Downtown Parking Structures 4 and 5, with a new slip-resistant and durable floors to better serve 800,000+ annual parkers.

These improvements are part of the city’s Realignment Plan, enhancing safety, appearance, and long-term performance in our busiest public facilities.
